name: Pydantic AI
what: A typed Python agent framework from the Pydantic team. You define agents with typed outputs and tools, and switching model providers is a one-string change. Companion packages add a harness for long-running agents (files, shell, sub-agents) and Pydantic Evals for testing. MIT licensed.
who: Python developers who like type hints and want validated, structured outputs from their agents.

setup.text: For a ready-made coding agent toolkit, add the harness too:
Set your provider's API key (for example OPENAI_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) and follow the docs at pydantic.dev/docs/ai.

prompts: Build a Pydantic AI agent that extracts invoice data into a typed Invoice model.
Add a tool to this agent that looks up a customer by email in our database.
Write Pydantic Evals tests for this agent's outputs.
